document.abstract: A description is given of the equipment devised to train gunners to hit fast-moving targets. The more important and novel features are discussed. The trainer not only reproduces for the observer any desired environment and target, but also correctly simulates conditions of fire in a way that otherwise could only be found in actual combat.
